data.title: Case 2A: Agent-Grills-Agent via Identity-Grounded Heterogeneous Debate (HDE) & Dialectical Scaffolding
data.description: Authoritative architectural reference for identity-grounded heterogeneous multi-agent debate (HDE), detailing how orthogonal axiomatic grounding, negative doctrinal boundary filtering (ID-RAG), heuristic Theory-of-Mind (ToM-Lite) opponent modeling, and Socratic Moderator perturbations prevent consensus collapse and sycophancy in Google Cloud ADK 2.0 and A2A adversarial debate rings.
